## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented change.

## Validation

- [ ] Backend format and lint
- [ ] Backend tests and coverage
- [ ] Frontend typecheck, tests, and lint

- [ ] Production dependency audit
- [ ] Desktop/release checks when packaging or runtime behavior changed

## Risk and data impact

Describe migration, privacy, security, compatibility, and rollback considerations. Confirm that no secrets or personal time-tracking data are included.

## DCO

- [ ] Commits are signed off with `git commit -s`
